meaning.en: no current at all: open power path, power key line or a bad boot cable
meaning.hi: current bilkul nahi: power path open, power key line, ya boot cable kharab

meaning.en: high current at once without pressing power: short on the battery line
meaning.hi: power dabaye bina turant zyada current: battery line pe short

meaning.en: current rises then drops back: the board starts and stops
meaning.hi: current badhta hai phir gir jata hai: board start hoke ruk jata hai

meaning.en: current sits at the supply limit: hard short, disconnect
meaning.hi: current limit pe atka hai: hard short, disconnect karo

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the VBAT pin
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black VBAT pin pe

label.en: Large capacitor beside the battery connector
label.hi: Battery connector ke paas bada capacitor

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the capacitor
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black capacitor pe

label.en: Series coil on the battery line, under the shield
label.hi: Battery line ki series coil, shield ke neeche

probe_note.en: One probe on each end of the coil
probe_note.hi: Coil ke dono ends pe ek ek probe

label.en: Power key line at the side button
label.hi: Side button pe power key line

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the power key pad
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black power key pad pe

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the VBUS pin
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black VBUS pin pe

label.en: Charging IC input, after the port protection
label.hi: Charging IC ka input, port protection ke baad

probe_note.en: Red probe on ground, black on the input capacitor
probe_note.hi: Red probe ground pe, black input capacitor pe

label.en: diode reading at the battery connector VBAT pin
label.hi: battery connector VBAT pin pe diode reading

label.en: diode reading at the battery-line capacitor
label.hi: battery line capacitor pe diode reading

label.en: diode reading on the power key line
label.hi: power key line pe diode reading

label.en: heat or rosin check on the battery line
label.hi: battery line pe heat ya rosin check

label.en: current drawn through the charging port
diode reading at the charging port VBUS pin
label.hi: charging port VBUS pin pe diode reading

label.en: diode reading at the charging IC input
label.hi: charging IC input pe diode reading

name.en: Shorted capacitor on the battery line

fix.en: Remove the shorted capacitor beside the battery connector, then re-check the line.
fix.hi: Battery connector ke paas wala short capacitor nikaalo, phir line dobara check karo.

trainee.en: A capacitor on the battery line has failed short, so current flows straight to ground the moment power is connected.
trainee.hi: Battery line ka ek capacitor short ho gaya hai, isliye power lagate hi current seedha ground mein jata hai.

expert.en: Battery-line cap shorted: immediate draw, near-zero diode on VBAT, the cap heats under injection.
expert.hi: VBAT cap short: turant draw, VBAT pe diode lagbhag zero, injection pe cap garam.

name.en: Power IC shorted on the battery line
name.hi: Battery line pe power IC short

fix.en: The power IC is shorted. Needs IC replacement by a technician.
fix.hi: Power IC short hai. Technician se IC replace karwana hoga.

trainee.en: The power IC itself is shorted inside, so the whole battery line reads near zero and the IC gets hot.
trainee.hi: Power IC andar se short hai, isliye poori battery line zero ke paas dikhti hai aur IC garam hota hai.

expert.en: PMIC short on VBAT: same line readings as a cap short; heat locates it at the IC.
expert.hi: VBAT pe PMIC short: cap short jaisi readings; heat se IC pe pata chalta hai.

name.en: Faulty boot cable or supply lead
name.hi: Boot cable ya supply lead kharab

fix.en: Replace or re-seat the boot cable and check the supply leads.
fix.hi: Boot cable badlo ya theek se lagao, supply leads check karo.

trainee.en: No current can also mean the cable never reached the board. Check it first: it is the cheapest check.
trainee.hi: Current na aaye to ho sakta hai cable board tak pahunchi hi nahi. Pehle yahi check karo, sabse aasaan hai.

expert.en: Common false lead for no-current: cable or lead fault.
expert.hi: No-current ka common false lead: cable ya lead fault.

name.en: Open coil on the battery line

fix.en: Replace the open series coil on the battery line.
fix.hi: Battery line ki open series coil badlo.

trainee.en: The coil that carries battery current is broken, so nothing reaches the board.
trainee.hi: Battery current le jaane wali coil tooti hai, isliye board tak kuch nahi pahunchta.

expert.en: Open series element on VBAT: connector side reads OL, board side normal.
expert.hi: VBAT pe series element open: connector side OL, board side normal.

name.en: Fault on the power key line

fix.en: Repair the power key line: check the key and its track.
fix.hi: Power key line theek karo: key aur uska track check karo.

trainee.en: The battery line is fine, but the power key signal never reaches the power IC, so it never starts.
trainee.hi: Battery line theek hai, par power key ka signal power IC tak nahi pahunchta, isliye start nahi hota.

expert.en: Open power key line: VBAT normal, key line OL.
expert.hi: Power key line open: VBAT normal, key line OL.

trainee.en: The port's VBUS pin no longer connects to the board, so no charging current gets in.
trainee.hi: Port ka VBUS pin board se connect nahi hota, isliye charging current andar nahi aata.

expert.en: Port open on VBUS: no port current, VBUS OL, charging path normal.
expert.hi: VBUS pe port open: port current nahi, VBUS OL, charging path normal.

name.en: Failed part in the charging path

fix.en: Replace the failed charging-path part after the port protection.
fix.hi: Port protection ke baad wala kharab charging part badlo.

trainee.en: The port is fine, but a part after it has failed, so the charging IC never gets power.
trainee.hi: Port theek hai, par uske baad ka part kharab hai, isliye charging IC ko power nahi milti.

expert.en: Charging path fault: VBUS normal, IC input shorted.
expert.hi: Charging path fault: VBUS normal, IC input short.

name.en: Board fine: the cable or charger is at fault
name.hi: Board theek: cable ya charger kharab

fix.en: No board fault found: try a known-good cable and charger.
fix.hi: Board mein fault nahi: achha cable aur charger try karo.

trainee.en: With a good supply on the port the board draws normal current, so the board itself charges.
trainee.hi: Port pe achhi supply se board normal current leta hai, matlab board khud charge karta hai.

expert.en: Normal port current with a bench supply: external fault.
expert.hi: Bench supply se port current normal: bahar ka fault.

diode_mode.en: Diode mode shows the voltage drop across a junction, in volts.
diode_mode.hi: Diode mode junction ka voltage drop dikhata hai, volt mein.

boot_current.en: Boot current is the current the board draws when it is powered and switched on.
boot_current.hi: Boot current woh current hai jo board power aur switch on hone pe leta hai.

vbat.en: VBAT is the main supply line from the battery connector into the board.
vbat.hi: VBAT battery connector se board mein jaane wali main supply line hai.

current_limit.en: The current limit caps how much current the supply will give, which protects the board.
current_limit.hi: Current limit supply ka maximum current hai, jo board ko bachata hai.

short.en: A short is a near-zero resistance path to ground.
short.hi: Short matlab ground tak lagbhag zero resistance ka raasta.

ol.en: OL means open: no connection between the probes.
ol.hi: OL matlab open: probes ke beech connection nahi.
